title: Paired failure taxonomy
label: tab:exp40-failure-taxonomy
caption: Paired failure taxonomy.
description: This table reports the rates and counts of recovered, unrecovered, and side-effect outcomes across 5,247 eligible pairs, together with the recovery-minus-side-effect balance. Its purpose is to evaluate the registered benefit-harm criterion and keep adverse outcomes visible in the paper's evidence record.
context_notes: The taxonomy covers 5,247 eligible paired outcomes.
Category values are rates in percent; recovery minus side effect is a percentage-point difference.
Side effects exceed recoveries, so the registered benefit-over-harm criterion is missed.
